name: Image variations
summary: POST /v1/images/variations with `model: dall-e-2` — generate variations of an existing image. DALL·E 2 only.
description: `POST /v1/images/variations` creates alternate images from an uploaded source image. The OpenAI surface only supported `dall-e-2`, so the user problem was image-to-image variation rather than prompt-only generation.
notes: Cannot be probed: Azure Foundry does not expose `POST /v1/images/variations`, and OpenAI shut down `dall-e-2` on 2026-05-12 with no Azure equivalent; `gpt-image-2` is the replacement image model but does not support variations. Sources: https://platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations and https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-foundry/openai/concepts/models.
